newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS cuts-Montgomery.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS cuts-Montgomery.

text.p: Montgomery Securities analyst Jonathan Joseph lowered his 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates on Intel Corp, due to deeper-than-expected price cuts by the semiconductor giant, a Montgomery spokeswoman said.
-- Joseph left his second quarter estimates of $1.75 a share intact and maintains a buy rating on the stock.
-- Joseph cut his 1997 estimate to $7.80 a share, from $8.12 a share and cut 1998 estimates to $9.25 from $9.85.
-- Joseph was not available for comment.
-- Intel shares were up 2-05/16 to 141-05/16, but falling back from an intra-session high of 143.
